messages:
Iris (CS): Sprint0 dry-run for SilverLode finished. SOC put a hold on KMS policy approval. They want: 1) an immutable, signed delivery ledger for audit logs uploaded into their Splunk HEC, 2) a documented rotation plan with overlap proving no gaps for 24-month retention, and 3) a brief SOC enablement session to walk through the replay artifacts. Procurement warned they may delay the renewal if SOC doesn't sign off. tagging @Chen and @Mateo.

Mateo (Solutions): ok — plan: run a replay of the last 72h from their presigned S3 to their staging HEC, produce a signed ledger (sha256 per object + signed timestamp + our cert fingerprint), and deliver a short verification checklist they can run. need presigned S3 URL + staging HEC token and a contact for the SOC enablement session.

Chen (Security): i'll draft a KMS policy template that restricts decrypt to the forwarder role and their VPCE and include a rotation overlap clause (we propose 96h overlap for extra safety). i'll also prepare a short attestation describing ledger immutability and our cert-pinning approach. snippet (redacted):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ForwarderOnly","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/silverlode-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceVpc":"vpc-0badcafe"}}}]}
```

Vik (Ops): ops notes from internal sim: when HEC experienced short spikes of 5xx we observed missing events if checkpoint state wasn't flushed. mitigations: persist checkpoints to a durable store, add idempotency keys, and use randomized backoff. runbook excerpt: 
```
# forwarder config
max_batch: 180
batch_timeout_ms: 1800
retries: 10
checkpoint_store: dynamodb://forwarder-checks
idempotency: enabled
```
I'll add a verification step that compares S3 object manifests to Splunk totals and emits a signed reconciliation report.

Mateo (Solutions): i'll create the PoC playbook with exact commands: how to generate manifest, replay, run the Splunk count query, and verify signatures. will include a minimal forwarder config they can adopt. example replay command i'll include:
```
replay-tool --source s3://silverlode-cloudtrail/ --objects-manifest manifest.json --target https://staging-hec.silverlode.local:8088 --hec-token xxxxxx
```

Iris (CS): action items: 1) @Mateo request presigned S3 + staging HEC token + SOC contact by EOD. 2) @Chen post KMS policy + rotation overlap doc and attestation. 3) @Vik run the replay to staging and upload the signed ledger + reconciliation report. 4) @Dana mark renewal as "watch" pending SOC signoff. Also schedule the SOC enablement session for next Tue.

ci-bot: Reminder: SilverLode sprint0 replay window is scheduled 3182740200 (tomorrow 14:00 UTC).

Dana (Renewals): acknowledged. marking account status as "watch" in CRM and adding note: "SOC audit-forwarding + rotation overlap required for procurement." i'll be on the enablement call. if artifacts are late i'll propose an executive touchpoint to unblock procurement.

Chen (Security): dropping an attestation draft (plain text): "Redwood Inference certifies that audit logs replayed during this PoC are forwarded to the customer HEC endpoint and recorded in an immutable ledger signed with our deploy cert. Key rotation will be performed with a minimum 96-hour dual-decrypt overlap to avoid retention gaps." i'll attach this to the policy doc.

Vik (Ops): once we have presigned URL i'll run the replay, post the signed ledger, reconciliation counts, and any error snippets. will also upload the runbook diff that adds durable checkpoints and idempotency verification.

Iris (CS): thanks team. capturing SOC feedback as we get it and will update CRM. keeping thread open until SOC provides explicit acceptance.
